propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline as authoritative but nothing couples those citations to the criteria registry, so a criterion's rubric can change and prose paraphrases silently become false.
A new pin manifest gate digests each cited criterion's authoritative registry text and fails when a cited criterion changes, naming the guide, criterion, and remedy of re-verify-and-re-pin.
The gate reports four problem classes: unknown citation, stale pin, orphan pin, and missing manifest.

Citation extraction is vocabulary-only against the closed CANONICAL_LLM id set at word boundaries, depending on no guide markup so prose edits and restructures do not break the gate, at the cost of possible spurious pins for word-like ids (fails safe).
The gate is folded into validate-routing composition so it runs in CI with no new workflow step, and covers every guide in AUTHOR_GUIDES.
The gate complements existing bespoke G6/828a semantic tests rather than replacing them; without the pin gate a contradictory rule appended to plan_review_F1.md left validate-routing reporting OK.
